source_note: Facts cross-checked against the app's question bank and standard references.

bullets.en: Ideal gas law: PV = nRT. R = 8.314 J·mol⁻¹·K⁻¹ = 0.0821 L·atm·mol⁻¹·K⁻¹.
bullets.ne: आदर्श ग्यास नियम: PV = nRT। R = 8.314 J·mol⁻¹·K⁻¹ = 0.0821 L·atm·mol⁻¹·K⁻¹।

bullets.en: Avogadro's number = 6.022×10²³; moles = mass ÷ molar mass.
bullets.ne: एभोगाड्रो सङ्ख्या = 6.022×10²³; मोल = पिण्ड ÷ मोलर पिण्ड।

bullets.en: Wurtz reaction: 2RX + 2Na (dry ether) → R−R (a symmetrical alkane).
Zero order: rate = k, half-life t½ = [A]₀/2k. First order: rate = k[A].
bullets.ne: शून्य कोटि: दर = k, अर्धायू t½ = [A]₀/2k। प्रथम कोटि: दर = k[A]।

bullets.en: A hydrogen fuel cell converts H₂ + O₂ chemical energy into electricity (used in the Apollo missions).
bullets.ne: हाइड्रोजन इन्धन सेलले H₂ + O₂ को रासायनिक ऊर्जालाई विद्युत्मा बदल्छ (अपोलो अभियानमा प्रयोग)।

bullets.en: Atomic numbers: H 1, He 2, C 6, N 7, O 8, Na 11, Cl 17, K 19.
bullets.ne: परमाणु सङ्ख्या: H 1, He 2, C 6, N 7, O 8, Na 11, Cl 17, K 19।

bullets.en: Common acids: citric (citrus fruits), acetic (vinegar), hydrochloric (stomach).
bullets.ne: सामान्य अम्ल: सिट्रिक (अमिलो फल), एसेटिक (सिरका), हाइड्रोक्लोरिक (पेट)।

bullets.en: The pH scale was introduced by Sørensen (1909).
Most reactive metals: K, Na (alkali metals); noble gases are inert.
bullets.ne: सबैभन्दा क्रियाशील धातु: K, Na (क्षार धातु); अक्रिय ग्यास निष्क्रिय।

bullets.en: Water: H₂O; electrolysis of water gives H₂ and O₂ in a 2:1 ratio.
bullets.ne: पानी: H₂O; पानीको विद्युत् विश्लेषणले H₂ र O₂ 2:1 अनुपातमा दिन्छ।
